purpose: Define the gates that must pass before LangGraph can become the default Agent V2 backend

gates.name: Native parity
gates.evidence: LangGraph has create_run, execute_run, get_run, list_runs, get_trace. Missing plan_run, pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run. /v2/chat/agent schema stable per 08F1 tests.
gates.required_next_action: Implement plan_run, pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run in LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 and add parity tests against Native behavior.

gates.name: Governance parity
gates.evidence: 08F4-R2 audit verified escalate_auto_mode_effective, _governance_gate_node, READ_ONLY_TOOL_NAMES, WRITE_TOOL_NAMES. No broker tools in SUPPORTED_READ_TOOLS.
gates.required_next_action: Continue enforcing SUPPORTED_READ_TOOLS whitelist; reject any trading/broker tool additions without separate risk-governance front.

gates.name: Failure-mode safety
criteria: invalid backend falls back to Native
missing LangGraph dependency falls back to Native
gates.evidence: 08F4-R2 verified timeout (BUG-08F4-03), malformed run state (BUG-08F4-01), auto escalation (BUG-08F4-02). 08E tests verify invalid/missing backend fallback.
gates.required_next_action: Add default-promotion-specific failure-mode tests (memory pressure, concurrent runs, provider outage simulation).

gates.name: Observability
criteria: dashboard can show enough state to diagnose failures
gates.evidence: API adapter exposes backend, backend_selected, backend_fallback_used, backend_fallback_reason. Trace retrieval works. Dashboard status route shows backend but does not expose backend_fallback_reason (GAP-08F5-04).
gates.required_next_action: Close GAP-08F5-04 by surfacing backend_fallback_reason in dashboard status before default promotion front.

gates.name: Rollback
gates.evidence: 08F5 rollback_runbook documents 7-step procedure. runtime.py already falls back to Native when env unset or invalid. 08E selector guard tests pass.
gates.required_next_action: Add a default-promotion rollback test that verifies flipping a config default back to Native at runtime.

gates.name: Test/CI
gates.evidence: 08F5: 37/37 smoke tests passed; py_compile and hygiene passed; phase1-ci and nontrading-smoke-regression green.
gates.required_next_action: Add CI matrix job that runs LangGraph-specific tests under AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph so default promotion cannot hide failures.

gates.name: Knowledge/Memory boundary
criteria: Human approval required for knowledge promotion
gates.evidence: LangGraph uses MemoryGatewayV2 but does not auto-promote memory. No FAISS rebuild in runtime. Existing promotion queues require explicit fronts.
gates.required_next_action: Codify memory-boundary contract in a separate front before LangGraph default promotion; ensure memory writes remain gated.

gates.name: Operational cost and model routing
gates.evidence: Native runtime uses finalize_agent_run provider metadata. LangGraph graph uses same finalizer path. No expensive model hardcoded. Explicit cost/step budgets not yet documented as runtime policy.
gates.required_next_action: Document cost/step/model-routing policy in governance_and_human_gate_plan and enforce in LangGraph nodes before default promotion.

gates.name: Human operator control
gates.evidence: Governance gate escalates auto write-intent to approval_required. Runtime fallback can be triggered by unsetting env. TraceStore and run.json provide audit trail.
gates.required_next_action: Add explicit human-interrupt wiring in LangGraph graph (LangGraph interrupts) for long-running default-mode runs.
